candidates.title: [Bug]: `check` in a class field initializer compiles when init can't return an error, then `new` crashes with a Go interface-conversion error
[Bug]: conditional expression is never treated as an isolated expression (rejected when returned from a lock in an isolated class)
[Bug]: resource methods whose paths diverge at a non-singleton segment are not rejected
[Bug]: including a `service`/`client` object type with `*T` is accepted without the matching qualifier
[Bug]: error constructor rejects a list-constructor literal as a detail named arg

notes:
Hit the 5-confirmed-candidate limit at ~25 min; the strings/typedesc hunter was stopped early.
The GitHub search/issues endpoint returns 403 in this environment ('sessions are bound to their configured repositories'). Dedup was done by listing all 840 issues via repos/.../issues?state=all with page=N (gh --paginate also 403s on next-page links) and filtering locally.
Most findings were already filed and were dropped: #1091, #1132, #1093, #1047, #1129, #1149, #1134, #1050, #1026, #1169, #1218, #1285 (closed not planned), #1046, #1110, #1403, #1054, #1347, #1148.
Confirmed but NOT included (6th confirmed candidate, over the limit): decimal zero loses its exponent in toString/println (`0.00d` prints `0`, so `decimal:fromString(z.toString()) === z` is false). Dedup found no existing issue; spec-validated via the lang.decimal fromString doc ('inverse of value:toString') plus §6.29 `===` precision. Caveat: decimal/decimal.go FormatBallerina() collapses zero to "0" on purpose, presumably to match jBallerina. Repro: /tmp/.../scratchpad/numeric/decimal-zero-tostring-v.bal (session-local).
Unverified lead (not deduped or validated, over the limit): a resource-method-decl inside an object type descriptor (`type T client object { resource function get users/[int id]() returns int; }`) gives `fatal[INTERNAL_ERROR]: unexpected member kind in object type descriptor`. subset10 lists resource-method-decl as a supported object-type member. Worth checking next run.
Other unverified observations: method call on `self` in init before all fields are assigned compiles and crashes with a Go interface-conversion message (probably covered by #1395); `xml:strip` on `<x/> <!--c-->t` drops the merged whitespace text.
https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/ served the 2022R4-era text (no group by/collect section), so group by/collect semantics were not checked against the spec.
